modules.name: Portfolio Compiler

seed_evidence.claim: Browser-local language-model inference can be technically viable for suitably sized models.
seed_evidence.note: WebGPU/WebAssembly browser inference; reported up to ~80% native performance on the same device.

seed_evidence.claim: TMS may improve global cognition after stroke, but the evidence base remains heterogeneous.
seed_evidence.note: Meta-analysis of 10 RCTs / 414 participants; high heterogeneity and mixed domain-specific outcomes.

seed_evidence.claim: An internal model confidence score is equivalent to external correctness.
seed_evidence.note: The architecture explicitly rejects this equivalence.
